narrative.overview: Cream background, white task surfaces, navy home hero and actions, pale blue evidence band, cream footer. Preserve verified content and functional interactions.
keyCharacteristics: Cream #f7f4ec page and footer; white cards, inputs and dialogs; navy hero and primary action; pale blue notices.
Plus Jakarta Sans: 400, 600, 800, and 700 for the wordmark only.
Lucide-style 24px-grid stroke icons; decorative, text carries meaning.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px warm borders and tonal bands; shadows only on floating popovers and the floating header.
Source, PDF page, and check date always adjacent to the number they support.
Status by word, icon and line style (solid vs dashed), never by colour alone.
Header shape change 420ms; reduced motion disables animation.

rules.name: The No-Verdict Rule
rules.body: No red, green, or traffic-light colours anywhere. A program's status is written in words; "Belum diketahui" uses a dashed Garis Tegas outline, never a warning colour.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Tinta Arsip is the only accent hue. New emphasis comes from weight, size, or Kabut Biru, not from a second accent.

rules.name: The Stabilo Rule
rules.body: Stabilo yellow marks something the reader must fill in or act on (placeholders, the correction contact, a just-added line). It never marks data.

rules.name: The Source Caption Rule
rules.body: Every number's source sits in Caption directly under or beside it, never in a footnote at the page end.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Money, figures, table cells, and calendar days use tabular numerals so columns of rupiah align.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Cards and sections never cast shadows. If something needs to stand out, give it a line or a band, or make it the primary action.

dos: **Do** put the source document, PDF page, and check date in Caption next to every figure.
**Do** keep "Pagu indikatif, bukan APBD dan bukan realisasi" as a chip or caption beside every spending block.
**Do** write status in words and draw "Belum diketahui" with a dashed outline.
Respect reduced motion; preserve 420ms header shape change and existing demo playback.
**Do** keep charts and cards fully drawn by default so print, screenshots, and no-JS show final values.
**Do** theme browser surfaces: selection in Kabut Biru, caret and accent colour in Tinta Arsip, thin scrollbars in Garis Tegas.
**Do** use the SVG icon set (16px grid, 1.6px stroke, currentColor) for arrows, close, check, calendar, and chevrons.
donts: **Don't** use red, green, scores, rankings, or any colour that implies a verdict.
**Don't** compare or chart figures across regions, or place program pagu (juta rupiah) and bidang pagu (rupiah) on one scale.
**Don't** add shadows to cards or sections.
**Don't** use thick coloured side or top borders on cards, list items, or callouts.
**Don't** use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons.
**Don't** hide content until it is scrolled into view, or count numbers up.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a second typeface.
